result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now runs the same code as `updateLandscape`, with the same options. I compiled the `cli` module and its tests pass. I didn't run either command end to end, so I haven't seen `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` produce `config.json` and `index.html`. Nothing is committed.

- **`Commands.java`:** I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description, which says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. `usageInfo()` now lists `analyzeLandscape` in the no-argument overview.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`:** `run` dispatches both names to `updateLandscape`, which now takes the command name and description. `-help` therefore prints the usage of whichever name you typed.
- **`README.md`:** it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Landscape commands" section describing both names. It marks `updateLandscape` as the same command, kept for existing scripts.
